argv: Voluntary stop after completing Food for the crossing (stage 21), before Water for everyone. This was fresh logical-interface play from an authored stage-18 checkpoint, not a full-campaign or human-player claim. I continued because I wanted to discover the pond life, then enjoyed making a flora and provisions for the gathering. Sand plus glass making a lens, collecting pond water with the bowl, observing a leaf through the lens, cider changing to vinegar, and netting fish from the shore were satisfying. Botany was my favourite complete sequence: observe, draw, then join the drawing with the preserved specimen collection. The food chapter was straightforward and pleasantly so, not a difficulty problem. Weather was more routine, and I expected windsock plus paper to make a wind record by analogy with rain-gauge plus paper; it did not. I used two hints in optics, for glass and lens. Glass plus planks making a glass slide remained obscure to me. I also tried plant plus bound-book before learning the plant first needed paper, which felt a fussy distinction. My biggest disappointment was making both Microscope and Pond slide, then getting No new combination here when I put the slide on the microscope. The invitation promised a country in a drop, but I never got an observation payoff there. Making the objects completed the request instead. By the end I wanted the actual gathering, not another preparation list; the next Water for everyone invitation did not pull me onward now. No tool or permission blocker. No visits, undo, or hidden-file inspection; earlier earned equipment and history were supplied by the checkpoint.
